## cap-evolve optimization task
You are running as the edit proposer for a cap-evolve optimization iteration.
Read `./INSTRUCTIONS.md` in this directory FIRST and follow it — it states the capability to improve, the failures to fix, and how your edit is judged.
For method/edit-space guidance, the optimization skills are available natively under `.claude/skills/` and under `./guidance/` (capability skill(s) + the diagnose failure-clustering method).
Cross-iteration files (clean ownership): `./LEDGER.md` (framework facts — every iteration's outcome + tasks broken/fixed), `./JOURNAL.md` (YOUR append-only handover across the whole run — append your entry below the marker), `./PROCESS.md` (YOUR required explainability for this iteration), and `./RUNMAP.md` + `./prior_iterations/<id>/` (every prior iteration's PROCESS.md + diff — read before proposing). Read all of these before you start.
